segs.en: G. Armando and the Mines

zh.ai: G. Armando 与地雷

segs.en: Armando had been through a lot. He had known defeat, survived questionable decisions and learned, almost always the hard way, that not all roads lead to happiness.

zh.ai: 阿曼多经历了许多。他曾遭遇失败，挺过了种种令人质疑的决定，也几乎总是以惨痛的方式学会了，并非所有道路都通向幸福。

segs.en: After so many experiences, he decided to leave chaos behind. He meditated, found inner peace and reached a deep state of zen. Then, with the serenity of someone who finally understands the universe, he thought: "A true man cannot step on any mine."

zh.ai: 经历了这么多事情后，他决定告别混乱。他静心冥想，找到了内心的平静，进入了深度禅定。随后，他带着终于参透宇宙真理般的平和心境想道：“真正的男人绝不会踩到任何地雷。”

segs.en: But fate still had one last test for him: crossing the dreaded battlefield known as Parque Lincoln. Reaching enlightenment does not include knowing the exact location of the explosives: all Armando has is a map with the regions where they might be. And, true to his new philosophy, Armando never steps back: he only moves right or up.

zh.ai: 但命运还为他准备了最后一道考验：穿越令人闻风丧胆的战场——Parque Lincoln。悟道并不意味着能知道炸药的确切位置：Armando 手里只有一张地图，上面标出了炸药可能所在的区域。而且，秉持着他的新哲学，Armando 从不后退：他只向右或向上移动。

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e8096f2c4b5dc71d7eeb4f272828328a16a8b94.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e8096f2c4b5dc71d7eeb4f272828328a16a8b94.png)

segs.en: Fictional illustration; it does not depict a real situation in the park.

zh.ai: 虚构示意图；并未描绘公园中的真实情景。

segs.en: Parque Lincoln is a grid of $$$H$$$ rows and $$$W$$$ columns. Cell $$$(x, y)$$$ is in column $$$x$$$, counted from left to right, and in row $$$y$$$, counted from bottom to top. The bottom-left corner is $$$(1, 1)$$$.

zh.ai: Parque Lincoln 是一个有 $$$H$$$ 行、$$$W$$$ 列的网格。单元格 $$$(x, y)$$$ 位于从左向右数第 $$$x$$$ 列、从下向上数第 $$$y$$$ 行。左下角是 $$$(1, 1)$$$。

segs.en: The map marks $$$K$$$ rectangles that do not share cells. Each rectangle has exactly one mine, in one of its $$$S$$$ cells, chosen at random: each cell has probability $$$1/S$$$, independently of the other rectangles. Outside the rectangles there are no mines.

zh.ai: 地图上标出了 $$$K$$$ 个互不共享格子的矩形。每个矩形中恰好有一枚地雷，它随机位于其 $$$S$$$ 个格子中的一个：每个格子被选中的概率均为 $$$1/S$$$，且各个矩形之间相互独立。矩形外没有地雷。

segs.en: Armando goes from $$$A = (x_A, y_A)$$$ to $$$B = (x_B, y_B)$$$, and in each step he moves from $$$(x, y)$$$ to $$$(x + 1, y)$$$ or to $$$(x, y + 1)$$$. Before leaving, without knowing where the mines are, he chooses his whole path. The number of mines of a path is the number of mines in its cells, counting $$$A$$$ and $$$B$$$.

zh.ai: Armando 从 $$$A = (x_A, y_A)$$$ 前往 $$$B = (x_B, y_B)$$$，每一步都会从 $$$(x, y)$$$ 移动到 $$$(x + 1, y)$$$ 或 $$$(x, y + 1)$$$。出发前，他不知道地雷的位置，但会先选定整条路径。一条路径上的地雷数是指路径经过的格子中的地雷数量，包括 $$$A$$$ 和 $$$B$$$。

segs.en: Help Armando: what is the minimum expected value of the number of mines on his path?

zh.ai: 帮助 Armando：他的路径上地雷数量的最小期望值是多少？

segs.en: The first line contains three integers $$$H$$$, $$$W$$$ and $$$K$$$.
The second line contains four integers $$$x_A$$$, $$$y_A$$$, $$$x_B$$$ and $$$y_B$$$.

Each of the following $$$K$$$ lines contains four integers $$$x_1$$$, $$$y_1$$$, $$$x_2$$$ and $$$y_2$$$: the rectangle formed by the cells $$$(x, y)$$$ with $$$x_1 \le x \le x_2$$$ and $$$y_1 \le y \le y_2$$$. Its number of cells is $$$S = (x_2 - x_1 + 1)(y_2 - y_1 + 1)$$$.
Constraints

zh.ai: 约束条件

segs.en: $$$0 \le K \le \min(10^5, H \cdot W)$$$

zh.ai: $$$0 \le K \le \min(10^5, H \cdot W)$$$

segs.en: $$$1 \le x_A \le x_B \le W$$$ and $$$1 \le y_A \le y_B \le H$$$

zh.ai: $$$1 \le x_A \le x_B \le W$$$ 和 $$$1 \le y_A \le y_B \le H$$$

segs.en: $$$1 \le x_1 \le x_2 \le W$$$ and $$$1 \le y_1 \le y_2 \le H$$$

zh.ai: $$$1 \le x_1 \le x_2 \le W$$$ 和 $$$1 \le y_1 \le y_2 \le H$$$

segs.en: No cell belongs to more than one rectangle.

zh.ai: 没有任何一个单元格属于多个矩形。

segs.en: The minimum expected value is an irreducible fraction $$$a/b$$$. Print $$$a \cdot b^{-1} \bmod (10^9 + 7)$$$, where $$$b^{-1}$$$ is the integer such that $$$b \cdot b^{-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{10^9 + 7}$$$. It can be shown that it always exists.

zh.ai: 最小期望值是一个最简分数 $$$a/b$$$。请输出 $$$a \cdot b^{-1} \bmod (10^9 + 7)$$$，其中 $$$b^{-1}$$$ 是满足 $$$b \cdot b^{-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{10^9 + 7}$$$ 的整数。可以证明，这样的整数总是存在。

segs.en: The minimum is taken over the real values, not over their remainders modulo $$$10^9 + 7$$$.

zh.ai: 最小值是在实数范围内取的，而不是对它们取模 $$$10^9 + 7$$$ 后得到的余数。

segs.en: Example 1. The rectangles have $$$3$$$, $$$2$$$ and $$$1$$$ cells. The path $$$(1, 1) \to (2, 1) \to (3, 1) \to (4, 1) \to (4, 2) \to (4, 3)$$$ goes through one cell of the first and one of the second, and its expected value is $$$\frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{5}{6}$$$. No path has a smaller expected value. Since $$$5 \cdot 6^{-1} \bmod (10^9 + 7) = 833\,333\,340$$$, that is the answer.

zh.ai: 示例 1。矩形分别有 $$$3$$$、$$$2$$$ 和 $$$1$$$ 个单元格。路径 $$$(1, 1) \to (2, 1) \to (3, 1) \to (4, 1) \to (4, 2) \to (4, 3)$$$ 经过第一个矩形中的一个单元格和第二个矩形中的一个单元格，其期望值为 $$$\frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{5}{6}$$$。没有路径的期望值更小。由于 $$$5 \cdot 6^{-1} \bmod (10^9 + 7) = 833\,333\,340$$$，这就是答案。

segs.en: Example 2. There is only one path and it goes through all the cells of both rectangles, so it has exactly $$$2$$$ mines.

zh.ai: 示例 2。只有一条路径，且它经过两个矩形中的所有格子，因此恰好有 $$$2$$$ 个地雷。

segs.en: I. Cancelled

zh.ai: I. 已取消

segs.en: The Gossip Club 2880 was founded and its $$$n$$$ members are furious. So furious that each of them is going to try to cancel ("funar") one person of the club, chosen at random. They are so crazy that they can even cancel themselves.

zh.ai: Gossip Club 2880 成立了，其 $$$n$$$ 名成员都怒不可遏。愤怒至极的他们决定每人随机选择俱乐部中的一个人来取消(“funar”)。他们甚至疯狂到会取消自己。

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be8755bfd4ed01d963d1f19a494bec4870b4dfda.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be8755bfd4ed01d963d1f19a494bec4870b4dfda.png)

segs.en: Each of the $$$n$$$ members chooses whom to cancel among the $$$n$$$ members, including themselves, with the same probability for each one. Each cancel attempt has a $$$p\%$$$ probability of being effective, regardless of what happens with the others. A person ends up cancelled ("funado") if at least one cancel attempt against them is effective. If there are several cancel attempts against a person, it is more likely that they end up cancelled.

zh.ai: $$$n$$$ 名成员中的每个人都会从 $$$n$$$ 名成员中(包括自己)等概率地选择一人进行“封杀”。每次封杀尝试都有 $$$p\%$$$ 的概率生效，且与其他尝试的结果无关。若针对某人的至少一次封杀尝试生效，则该人最终会被“封杀”(“funado”)。针对同一人的封杀尝试越多，其最终被封杀的概率就越大。

segs.en: What is the probability that exactly $$$k$$$ people end up cancelled?

zh.ai: 恰好有 $$$k$$$ 个人最终被取消的概率是多少？

segs.en: The first line contains an integer $$$T$$$, the number of test cases.

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$T$$$，表示测试用例的数量。

segs.en: Each of the following $$$T$$$ lines contains three integers $$$n$$$, $$$k$$$ and $$$p$$$.
Constraints

zh.ai: 约束条件

segs.en: $$$0 \le k \le n$$$

zh.ai: $$$0 \le k \le n$$$

segs.en: The sum of $$$n$$$ over all cases is at most $$$10^5$$$.

zh.ai: 所有测试用例中 $$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 $$$10^5$$$。

segs.en: For each case, the probability is an irreducible fraction $$$a/b$$$. Print on one line $$$a \cdot b^{-1} \bmod (998244353)$$$, where $$$b^{-1}$$$ is the integer such that $$$b \cdot b^{-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{998244353}$$$. It can be shown that it always exists.

zh.ai: 对于每种情况，概率都是一个最简分数 $$$a/b$$$。请在一行中输出 $$$a \cdot b^{-1} \bmod (998244353)$$$，其中 $$$b^{-1}$$$ 是满足 $$$b \cdot b^{-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{998244353}$$$ 的整数。可以证明，这样的整数总是存在。
